newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent staves off further losses in good buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent staves off further losses in good buying.

text.p: IPE futures extended losses briefly on Thursday at the NYMEX open before good buying came in to support the market, traders said.
July Brent was 28 cents lower at $18.43 a barrel at 1445 GMT, while June gas oil was $2.75 lower at $166 a tonne.
Some traders said it looked like the July Brent might hold around current levels.
"There's quite a lot buying at these levels and as long as the funds don't come in we should be okay," said one trader.
"We could be in for some type of technical reversal," said another trader although he noted key supports at $18.11 and $17.54 a barrel.
Traders said the falls came against a backdrop of sickly crude and products markets.
Physical North Sea Brent eased on Thursday amid slack demand, ample June supply as well as a closed arbitrage window to the United States.
"The shut arb to the States and a lack of demand from European refiners isn't really helping," the second trader said.
Physical products markets were also on the weak side.
